hypothesis: A pixel-wise fault probability built from label-free geophysical bands of training_features.tif (surface conductivity / depth to conductive base; dilatation rate, shear strain rate, 2nd strain-rate invariant; isostatic gravity anomaly + slope; magnetics RTP/TMI anomaly + vertical & horizontal slope; earthquake density) ranks geothermal structural zones above background. It targets physical proxies of active faulting and fluid flow rather than USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue membership, so it can surface faults missing from the catalogue.
mechanism: Locate feature bands by description metadata; percentile-normalize each band to [0,1] on valid pixels; average bands; apply mild contrast (x^1.25); write NaN where features are null. Output: single-band float32 GeoTIFF, EPSG:32611, 100 m, values in [0,1], nodata where features are null.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic or stratigraphic boundaries can produce gravity/magnetic/conductivity contrasts and localized strain without displacement (false positives).
